body:
Scope: independent M3 milestone Code Review of the actual committed deletion diff, amended approved plan, applicable Test/Workflow criteria and current m3-removal evidence. Exact source comparison is a98b6e3523869484b47f2ef5e1422276b36bea81 -> 2db663f6751c9b766107475073d32299a0d4fa7c. Structured subjects identify the surviving cache file and amended scope document; deleted subjects have no live file identity. Their exact baseline identities and observed current absence are recorded below, not represented by fabricated current hashes.

Authority and requirement alignment: the direct user instruction explicitly authorizes removing these named historical lifecycle and cache applicability tests. This is an exception to ordinary TEST-SR-08 preservation conditions and the original proposal cleanup bounds. It does not establish redundancy, replacement protection or retirement of still-supported runtime. No broader cache clarification is assumed answered. General Test policy remains unchanged; the exception is confined to the selected thirteen files and eleven methods.

Actual diff assessment: independently compared the deleted path set to the approved M3 inventory and the original/current cache ASTs. Exactly thirteen JS files are absent, exactly eleven selected test methods removed, and all fourteen retained test method ASTs equal their pre-removal definitions. No added methods. Only the newly unused validate_final_verification_result import was removed; other imports, helpers, fixtures and runtime implementations are unchanged. The current Node automatic discovery and Python unittest entrypoints remain valid. No unselected engineering file was changed by M3.

Protection and edge-case limitations: removed assertions cover still-supported final-verification vocabulary/freshness, historical settlement and routing, ownership, migration/repair, transactions/rollback, cache eligibility and unsafe lookup, dependency-resolution limits, branch/worktree locality, matching-pass reuse, invalidation and cache-only final-proof restrictions. These protections are intentionally lost within user scope. Retained green tests do not establish those deleted obligations. Hashing, normalization, serialization and all unlisted tests remain, without a claim that they replace this coverage. Historical document references to removed test commands remain historical evidence and cannot be presented as executable current proof.

Fresh proof: inspected m3-removal and actual completed logs. npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop reports 488 tests, 488 pass, zero skip/fail; prior 654 total less the executed selected 166 cases equals 488. The prior two skips were in deleted suites, so their absence is removal rather than repair. python scripts/test-validation-cache.py reports 14 passing methods versus baseline 25; the eleven selected removals fully explain the difference. Independent AST comparison confirms unchanged retained definitions, not merely equivalent counts. Plan/record validation and whitespace checks pass as recorded. These are remaining-suite/discovery checks, not preserved-protection evidence. Full expanded PR-mode CI remains running and is a separate final-closeout obligation.

Checklist: scoped requirement compliance passes under the explicit user exception; test/discovery accounting passes with disclosed reduction; edge/error/compatibility protection is reduced as requested, runtime unchanged; architecture and policy ownership unchanged; security/privacy implementation unchanged, regression protection reduced; generated package currency uses unchanged M1 scope and identities; unrelated-change check passes; current M3 proof adequate for this milestone. No performance or confidence improvement is inferred from fewer tests. The untracked inventory is not an engineering review subject.

No material implementation finding emerged against the authorized bounded amendment. This milestone assessment permits its owning workflow actor to disposition M3; it does not itself route, renew prior final/Verify records or grant external authority. After milestone closure, a distinct fresh independent whole-change review must integrate all delivered work and completed expanded CI, followed by distinct Verify with the protection-loss limitation retained.

independence_basis: Separate delegated nonauthor agent independently compared exact before/after subjects, scope, ASTs and completed proof. This reviewer authored no engineering or plan changes and writes only its own assessment; earlier independent allocation review is not implementation authorship.
